common_mistakes.mistake: Isp attempts to pass the glucose fold before pushing the signal sac into position as a step.
common_mistakes.consequence: The fold still blocks the floor route, so Isp cannot climb past it without the sac placement.
common_mistakes.recovery: Return to the shelf, push the light sac against the fold, then use it as the step to climb; the safe floor remains available and no mechanism must be reactivated. This is source/hint-derived, not an observed failure.
